This is the former Cornell-Queen's Executive MBA (boardroom format, partnership with Queen's University, Ontario). The current Cornell page presents it as 'Executive MBA Americas' with live online weekend classes plus four residential sessions; the Queen's dual-degree branding is no longer prominent on this page. johnson.cornell.edu/programs/emba/americas/ now 301-redirects here.
Eastern University's 100% online, self-paced (LifeFlex) MBA in Organizational Management, 30 credits, $9,900. Exact name and online delivery confirmed on page.

Emory Goizueta's only fully-online MBA is the Executive Online MBA (100% online, 6 hours of coursework/week, 18 months). Goizueta's Part-Time Evening MBA can also be completed fully online (goizueta.emory.edu/part-time-mba), so the exact intended program is slightly uncertain.

Georgia Tech / Scheller College of Business does not offer a fully online MBA. Its MBA options are Full-time, part-time Evening (up to half the coursework can be taken online) and Executive. Scheller's only fully online graduate business degree is an MS in Management, not an MBA. No confirmed online MBA URL.

IU's online MBA is the Kelley Direct Online MBA, run by the Kelley School of Business (administered from Bloomington but a single IU Kelley program covering the Indianapolis campus too). Confirmed online delivery, seven majors, admissions on page. Downgraded to medium because the page is branded IU Bloomington rather than IU Indianapolis.
Johns Hopkins Carey Business School's online MBA is the Flexible MBA: fully online, part-time, 54 credits, eight specializations. Program cell was blank; matched to the sheet's field (online MBA).

Rice Jones Graduate School of Business online MBA (MBA@Rice): 100% online classes, 54 credits, plus one in-person immersion and a global field experience. Used the official business.rice.edu page rather than the onlinebusiness.rice.edu marketing site.

Syracuse's online MBA is the Whitman School's 45-credit Online MBA (MBA@Syracuse). Verified on the page that its six specializations are accounting, business analytics, entrepreneurship, finance, marketing management and supply chain management - there is NO project management specialization, so the 'PROJECT MANAGEMENT' program label does not match any Whitman online MBA track.

Fisher College of Business Working Professional MBA, online delivery option. Note the page states classes require at least 30% live (synchronous) content, so it is distance-delivered rather than fully asynchronous. The umbrella WPMBA page is fisher.osu.edu/graduate/wpmba.
